headlines.title: The "trillion pound" oil fund the government believes Britain could have built
headlines.summary: For the first time, the Treasury calculates how much the UK could have raised by investing North Sea proceeds.

headlines.title: Riots in France: tourism sector fears drop in foreign visitors
headlines.summary: Images of the riots in France, broadcast worldwide, are already slowing hotel bookings, and tourism professionals fear ongoing violence will further deter foreign visitors.

headlines.title: AfD s Alice Weidel urges quick Ukraine talks and a return to cheap Russian energy
headlines.summary: Weidel said the far-right AfD is in "talks" to bridge differences with France’s National Rally that largely concern Russia.

headlines.title: Websites taken down worldwide as critical cyber-security update issued
headlines.summary: The vulnerabilities with PHP, a programming language widely used across the internet, have been described as the most significant ever found by AI.

headlines.title: EU should revive talks on broader China trade deal, top MEP says
headlines.summary: As EU lawmakers prepare to visit Beijing, the European Parliament's trade chief is calling for a broader agreement that could revive elements of a frozen investment pact and address unfair Chinese trade practices across multiple industries.

headlines.title: Why US investors are snapping up Germany s famed Mittelstand
headlines.summary: Increasing amounts of US capital are flowing into Germany s traditional industrial firms and family-owned businesses. As many business owners struggle to find successors, more companies are becoming acquisition targets.

headlines.title: Talking to Putin: Europe seeks a negotiator-in-chief for Ukraine
headlines.summary: European officials know they need to be able to speak to Russia’s leader directly. The problem is choosing who should do it.

headlines.title: Meta fined $25bn for 'lies' over user data privacy
headlines.summary: The fine is the largest to date against Facebook's owner, larger than an $18bn deal with California.

headlines.title: Ryanair CEO predicts biggest airfare rise in European history
headlines.summary: Ryanair boss Michael O’Leary predicts European airfares could rise by up to 20% in 2027 as higher fuel costs, taxes and reduced capacity put pressure on airlines.

headlines.title: Russia ready for 3-way talks on Ukraine war, Kremlin says
headlines.summary: "The conflict in Ukraine is coming to an end,” Vladimir Putin’s top aide told reporters.

headlines.title: Airbnb hosts can no longer make guests strip beds and wash dishes under new rules
headlines.summary: The updated policy will apply to all reservations booked on the accommodation site on or after 20 November.

headlines.title: What does Lufthansa gain from its €1.2 billion TAP Air Portugal deal and when?
headlines.summary: Lufthansa expects about €450 million a year in synergies from buying up to 49.9% of TAP Air Portugal for €1.2 billion, but Portugal’s continued control, lengthy regulatory reviews and the slow progress of its ITA Airways deal suggest the gains could take years to arrive.

headlines.title: Ex-DUP chief faces new allegation of raping woman inside Westminster
headlines.summary: A woman visiting the House of Commons in 2016 alleges that Jeffrey Donaldson tried to sexually assault her inside the Democratic Unionist Party’s Westminster offices.

headlines.title: The grads ditching the UK for a fresh start abroad
headlines.summary: With graduate jobs hard to come by, more young adults are reported to be considering emigrating.

headlines.title: Netflix shares drop on slowing engagement and revenue growth
headlines.summary: Netflix shares fell after its latest earnings failed to cheer investors as the streaming giant faces mounting competition and reportedly plans to cut around 1,000 jobs.

headlines.title: Le coût des ex-Premiers ministres a baissé de 500 000 euros
headlines.summary: Les avantages accordés aux anciens chefs du gouvernement ont augmenté en 2025, avant une première baisse attendue cette année, selon un document budgétaire obtenu par POLITICO.

headlines.title: Why is Elon Musk plotting a mega-merger of SpaceX and Tesla?
headlines.summary: Musk says there's "a lot to be gained" by combining the firms in what would be the biggest merger in history.

headlines.title: Elon Musk backs SpaceX-Tesla merger as rocket firm turns profit
headlines.summary: Elon Musk has signalled his support for a potential merger between SpaceX and Tesla, as SpaceX reported a sharp rise in revenue and its first quarterly profit since going public.

headlines.summary: Ces perquisitions s’inscrivent dans le cadre d’une enquête sur des soupçons d’utilisation irrégulière des fonds du Parlement européen par l’ancien groupe Identité et démocratie.

summary: EU의 강력한 규제 철퇴로 메타가 사상 최대 규모의 과징금을 부과받은 가운데, 독일 정부는 엔비디아와의 인공지능(AI) 협력을 체결하며 빅테크를 둘러싼 규제와 투자 유치가 교차하고 있습니다. 또한 프랑스 소요 사태와 루프트한자의 TAP 포르투갈 인수 등 지정학 및 항공·관광 섹터의 변동성도 확대되는 모습입니다.
